item.title: Dharmendra Birth Anniversary: When Dharmendra Became a ‘Per-Day’ Star for the Sake of Struggling Producers— And the Explosive Rumour That Fizzled Out Like a Sutli Bomb
item.description: By Sharad Rai He was a truly noble man. A star who was everyone’s friend — Dharmendra. Now that he has left this world, every person in the film industry seems to have a picture with him. Social media is flooded with his photos — Facebook, Instagram, X, and reels are full of people remembering him and sharing their personal stories. Among these many stories, one incident stands out—how Dharmendra, with his big heart, would often sign films of poor or low-budget producers out of sheer generosity.
